compliance.status: amended plan submitted after Program Decision Recommendation of non-compliance

notes: The OCR file is the First Amendment to the Fourth Round HEFSP (prepared February 24, 2026, submitted to courts February 27, 2026), not the original June 2025 plan. A Program Decision Recommendation (PDR) dated January 29, 2026 found the original HEFSP non-compliant and directed the Borough to amend it. DCA obligation: present_need=154, prospective_need=145 (matches plan). Plan uses structural conditions survey to reduce actionable rehab to 27-48 units. VLA originally gave RDP=8 for 4th Round; PDR directed revision to RDP=54. Unmet Need=91; Borough must address 25% (23 units) with realistic zoning. Borough proposes Market Street Redevelopment Plan (as amended) to satisfy the 23-unit 25% requirement. Note: Plan also includes additional sites for prior/3rd round obligations. 4th Round RDP sites: Meridia/Royal Warsaw (23 aff units), 689 River Drive (3 aff units), ElmPark 401-407 Rt 46 (9 aff units), Transitional/Sober Living (5 bedrooms, 10% cap credit); plus Market Street for 23-unit unmet need portion.
